title: Tailoring grain boundaries of solid-state electrolytes for building better all-solid-state lithium batteries
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,1514-1560
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01151A, Review Article
Yang Luo, Yuke Shen, Xiaofei Yang, Zhonghao Rao, Xueliang Sun, Xianfeng Li
This review summarizes grain boundaries in inorganic solid electrolytes, analyzing their impact on electron/ion transport and battery performance, and discusses modification strategies to overcome current electrolyte limitations.
